title: synthesize-papers output
description: Render-contract blocks and one render-contract table block whose `cites` are qualified `<slug>:<anchor>` keys (the cross-document cite form of search answers). With the `<slug>:` qualifiers removed, `blocks` must satisfy contracts/render-blocks.schema.json and `table` its `table` block; Python checks that, and that every cite is a passage of a paper in the set.

blocks.description: The synthesis, related-work style: heading, paragraph, bullets, callout, quote blocks.

table.description: One row per paper (first cell: its title), columns chosen by you: question, approach, data, headline result, limitation.
